title: Optional: Python packages from PyPI ask first (Install packages for the game)
context: Some worlds need Python packages that are on PyPI. Before Add, Update or Add from file, Archipelia previews the packages. If there are any, a dialog lists each one with its version and a link to PyPI, and says they install into the engine Python. Cancel installs nothing. Optional check.

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: network
setup.text: Needed. The world downloads and the package versions come from the network.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: world
setup.text: A world of the tab Archipelago index that declares Python packages in a requirements.txt. None is named, so you may have to try a few. Skip the test if none opens the dialog.

steps: Open Library, Games, tab Archipelago index. Find a world that declares Python packages (see the notes). Press Add on its card.
Before anything installs, a dialog titled Install packages for and the game name opens. It says the game needs these Python packages and that they install into the engine Python on this computer.
Read the lists. A heading Required by and the game name holds the packages of the world. A heading Their dependencies holds the rest. Each line is a package name and a version, shown as a link.
Press one link. Your browser opens the page of that package on PyPI, at that version.
Press Cancel. The dialog closes. The card still offers Add, the Installed figure in the status bar is unchanged and no toast shows.
Press Add again, then press Install packages and add. The card shows Adding..., moves to Installed, and a toast reads Installed with the game name and version.
Press Remove on that card and confirm with Delete, so the world is not left behind.
pass: Add on a world with packages opens the dialog first, with each package, its version and a working PyPI link, and nothing installs before you accept.
Cancel installs nothing and leaves the card as it was. Install packages and add installs the world.
fail: A world with packages installs with no question, or packages install after Cancel.
The dialog lists no versions, a link does nothing, or it opens a page that is not the package.
notes: No world in the index is known to declare packages. A world declares them when its .apworld holds a requirements.txt. Press Add on a world: the dialog opens only if it declares some. Say which world you used.
If no world opens the dialog, mark the whole test as not run.
Add from file takes the same path: an .apworld with a requirements.txt opens the same dialog. Optional.
The world that needs a package off PyPI is the Get this package test, not this one.
